items.problem: A WinUI 3 Popup (or a UserControl hosting one) opened via IsOpen=true without a XamlRoot silently never renders. The Compass calibration bar migrated structurally but never appeared on 'Unreliable'.
items.evidence: migration-score.json feature 'Calibration' verdict=partial (invokeOk=false, responded=false); migrated CalibrationBar.xaml.cs RequestCalibration() sets CalibrationPopup.IsOpen=true with no XamlRoot; discrepancies.json screenshot 03_Calibration__a03_Unreliable.png.
items.root_cause: The skill documents XamlRoot only for ContentDialog (MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Dialogs'). Popup has the identical requirement but was never mentioned, so the agent left the Popup's XamlRoot unset.
items.proposed_fix: (1) Add a 'Popup needs the same XamlRoot' subsection under the Dialogs pattern in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md with a code example. (2) Add a WARN heuristic in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 flagging .cs files that set Popup.IsOpen=true with no XamlRoot assignment (mirrors the existing background-task dead-control check).
items.generalizes: Popup-based overlays (banners, calibration/notification bars, custom teaching tips, flyout-like controls) are common in UWP samples and apps. UWP auto-attached popups to the CoreWindow; WinUI 3 requires XamlRoot on any popup not already in the live visual tree. This recurs in any migration that carries a code-instantiated Popup.
